title: Collection imagery: the Landscapes and Earth and sky collections in RISE Live, from the owner's review
acceptance: A rerunnable, keyless harvest (scripts/harvest-landscape-candidates.mjs) proposes candidates: every API field validated and bounded, every image probed, each chip composed by artwork-label.js; a work the owner has kept or cut is never offered again.
The owner reviews a sheet by eye at docs/assets/live/landscape-review.html; the reviewed sheet and the owner's decisions file are kept in src/content/landscapes/.

landscape-pins.js records every reviewed work's verdict (kept, cut by the owner by eye on 2026-10-26, favourite) and matches the decisions file exactly: Landscapes 68 kept and 112 cut, Earth and sky 65 kept and 13 cut.

scripts/build-landscape-catalog.mjs builds landscapes-catalog.generated.json from the kept works only, rights frozen at the harvest; --verify re-resolves every catalogued work at its source and exits 1 on any change in rights, owed credit or image.

Live has two collection engines beside astronomy, landscapes (sci-landscapes) and earth-and-sky (sci-earth-and-sky), with about lines, catalog words, the RISE-SDK rows, and no place in a host's guide; a collection opens on one of the owner's favourites, its credit under Sophia's circle; the first-load budget holds.
Human gate: the owner sees both collections in a real reading on the deployed /live, in the dark room and the light room.

evidence.note: Branch imagery-landscapes-candidates. node --test scripts/harvest-landscape-candidates.test.mjs scripts/build-landscape-catalog.test.mjs: 14 passed. harvest-science.mjs moved onto scripts/lib/collection-feeds.mjs with byte-identical ESO and NASA output.

npx vitest run on landscape-pins, provider, manifests, catalog-words, live guide, mask-ground, csp-image-hosts, rise-sdk, visual-cortex and visual-cortex.routing: all passed. The favourites test failed with the provider seam removed. A new cortex test failed first: a cue's prepared NASA work lost its acknowledgement (_asImageItem dropped creditRequired); fixed.

Owner's review by eye of the 258-work sheet (Landscapes 180, Earth and sky 78), 2026-10-26: 125 cuts (112 and 13), every other work kept; favourites Point Judith, Rhode Island (Heade), The Pink Cloud (Cross) and NASA Blue Marble 2007 West.

Agent observation, not a human's: the dev server, Demo reading, 'landscapes' then 'earth and sky', dark room and Porcelain light room at 1440x900 and 390x844. Both opened in the shell on a favourite (Point Judith; Blue Marble) with the credit captioned under the circle, the NASA acknowledgement included; no page errors. build-landscape-catalog --verify: 133 works, 0 changed. vite build and measure:first-load 63.3 KB of 64 KB; ci-hygiene clean.

Agent finding, not fixed here (PR #753 takes it): the Rijksmuseum adapter admits In Copyright images because it matches the metadata record's CC0. The 539 Rijksmuseum pins in museum-pins.js all have public-domain image rights.

activity.summary: Created and built on branch imagery-landscapes-candidates from the LIVE-IMAGERY owner decisions. Draft PR; not merged, not deployed, not reviewed by the owner.

Built the shipped collections from the owner's review: pins, catalog with verify mode, the landscapes and earth-and-sky engines, favourites first. Draft PR #752; not merged, not deployed, not accepted.

summary: Landscapes (68) and Earth and sky (65), pinned from the owner's review by eye, built into a frozen catalog with a verify mode, and shown in Live as two collection engines that open on the owner's favourites.
